notes: TBox expansion paired with history-replace-0007 (ancient Egyptian royal pyramid: a tomb -> a granary). Keeps the relation built_as and the new object a granary; the subject is a made-up class (the royal pyramids of an invented little-known pharaoh, Hetepkara) under the real class of Egyptian royal pyramids.
